title: Every admissible known-phase equal-magnitude complete-cube orbit has a positive leading gap

sign_classification.small_coupling_margin: For g<=8sqrt(3), 3gc_N<=3sqrt(3)/64 while the Fisher coefficient is at least 2eta^2c_N(3sqrt(3)/64).
sign_classification.large_coupling_margin: For g>=8sqrt(3), the Fisher coefficient is at least 2eta^2c_N(g/2)^(3/2), which strictly dominates 3g eta^2c_N^2 because g>1 and c_N<=1/512.
sign_classification.posterior_remainder: K1656 subtracts only O_(g,eta,R)(N^3), so the complete K1637 gap is at least c_(g,eta,R)N^4 for all sufficiently large N.
sign_classification.scope_guard: This closes every fixed admissible amplitude and known unit-phase angular pattern only inside the equal-magnitude complete-cube four-parameter orbit class; unrestricted anisotropic laws remain open.
